issue_context.title: [HTTP/3] Request headers not sent to the server on HttpContent flush when there is no data
comments: Triage: we should fix this. I know exactly where the problem is, it should be fairly easy to fix.

review_comments:
@ManickaP  It should not be a separate operation -- if there's no content, we need to send FIN flag together with headers as discussed here https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/55347
(current change effectively reverted https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/56221)

Ha, and I was like, well it doesn't matter, shutdown will send the FIN :smile: 
I'll put up a pr with a fix in a moment. I'll also add a comment to prevent similar reverts in the future. Good catch BTW, thanks!
